#!/usr/bin/env python3
from reportlab.lib.pagesizes import letter
from reportlab.pdfgen import canvas
from reportlab.lib.units import inch
from reportlab.pdfbase import pdfmetrics
from reportlab.pdfbase.ttfonts import TTFont

def create_i9_form(filename):
    """Create a sample I-9 form with fields for employee information."""
    c = canvas.Canvas(filename, pagesize=letter)
    width, height = letter
    
    # Title
    c.setFont("Helvetica-Bold", 16)
    c.drawCentredString(width/2, height - 50, "Form I-9")
    c.setFont("Helvetica-Bold", 12)
    c.drawCentredString(width/2, height - 70, "Employment Eligibility Verification")
    
    # Instructions
    c.setFont("Helvetica", 8)
    c.drawString(50, height - 100, "ANTI-DISCRIMINATION NOTICE: It is illegal to discriminate against any individual based on citizenship status or national origin.")
    
    # Section 1 Header
    c.setFont("Helvetica-Bold", 12)
    c.drawString(50, height - 130, "Section 1: Employee Information and Attestation")
    c.setFont("Helvetica", 8)
    c.drawString(50, height - 145, "(Employees must complete and sign Section 1 of Form I-9 no later than the first day of employment.)")
    
    # Employee information fields
    c.setFont("Helvetica", 10)
    
    # Last name, First name, Middle initial
    c.drawString(50, height - 170, "Last Name (Family Name):")
    c.rect(50, height - 185, 150, 20)
    
    c.drawString(210, height - 170, "First Name (Given Name):")
    c.rect(210, height - 185, 150, 20)
    
    c.drawString(370, height - 170, "Middle Initial:")
    c.rect(370, height - 185, 30, 20)
    
    # Other names field
    c.drawString(50, height - 210, "Other Names Used (if any):")
    c.rect(50, height - 225, 350, 20)
    
    # Address fields
    c.drawString(50, height - 250, "Address (Street Number and Name):")
    c.rect(50, height - 265, 350, 20)
    
    c.drawString(50, height - 290, "City or Town:")
    c.rect(50, height - 305, 150, 20)
    
    c.drawString(210, height - 290, "State:")
    c.rect(210, height - 305, 50, 20)
    
    c.drawString(270, height - 290, "ZIP Code:")
    c.rect(270, height - 305, 80, 20)
    
    # Date of birth
    c.drawString(50, height - 330, "Date of Birth (mm/dd/yyyy):")
    c.rect(50, height - 345, 100, 20)
    
    # U.S. Social Security Number
    c.drawString(160, height - 330, "U.S. Social Security Number:")
    c.rect(160, height - 345, 100, 20)
    
    # Email Address and Telephone
    c.drawString(270, height - 330, "Email Address:")
    c.rect(270, height - 345, 150, 20)
    
    c.drawString(50, height - 370, "Telephone:")
    c.rect(50, height - 385, 100, 20)
    
    # Attestation section
    c.setFont("Helvetica-Bold", 10)
    c.drawString(50, height - 410, "I attest, under penalty of perjury, that I am:")
    
    # Checkbox options
    c.rect(60, height - 430, 10, 10)
    c.drawString(75, height - 427, "A citizen of the United States")
    
    c.rect(60, height - 450, 10, 10)
    c.drawString(75, height - 447, "A noncitizen national of the United States")
    
    c.rect(60, height - 470, 10, 10)
    c.drawString(75, height - 467, "A lawful permanent resident")
    
    c.rect(60, height - 490, 10, 10)
    c.drawString(75, height - 487, "An alien authorized to work until")
    c.rect(250, height - 492, 80, 15)
    c.drawString(335, height - 487, "(expiration date, if applicable)")
    
    # Signature and date
    c.drawString(50, height - 520, "Signature of Employee (include dates if documents are not attached):")
    c.line(50, height - 535, 300, height - 535)
    
    c.drawString(320, height - 520, "Today's Date (mm/dd/yyyy):")
    c.rect(320, height - 535, 100, 20)
    
    # Page 2
    c.showPage()
    
    # Section 2 Header
    c.setFont("Helvetica-Bold", 12)
    c.drawString(50, height - 50, "Section 2: Employer or Authorized Representative Review and Verification")
    c.setFont("Helvetica", 8)
    c.drawString(50, height - 65, "(Employers or their authorized representatives must complete and sign Section 2 within 3 business days of the employee's first day of employment.)")
    
    # List of acceptable documents
    c.setFont("Helvetica-Bold", 10)
    c.drawString(50, height - 90, "List A: Documents that Establish Both Identity and Employment Authorization")
    c.setFont("Helvetica", 8)
    c.drawString(50, height - 105, "OR")
    c.setFont("Helvetica-Bold", 10)
    c.drawString(50, height - 125, "List B: Documents that Establish Identity")
    c.setFont("Helvetica", 8)
    c.drawString(250, height - 125, "AND")
    c.setFont("Helvetica-Bold", 10)
    c.drawString(300, height - 125, "List C: Documents that Establish Employment Authorization")
    
    # Document title from List A
    c.setFont("Helvetica", 10)
    c.drawString(50, height - 150, "Document Title:")
    c.rect(50, height - 165, 200, 20)
    
    # Issuing Authority
    c.drawString(260, height - 150, "Issuing Authority:")
    c.rect(260, height - 165, 150, 20)
    
    # Document Number
    c.drawString(50, height - 190, "Document Number:")
    c.rect(50, height - 205, 150, 20)
    
    # Expiration Date
    c.drawString(210, height - 190, "Expiration Date (if any) (mm/dd/yyyy):")
    c.rect(210, height - 205, 100, 20)
    
    # Signature and date
    c.drawString(50, height - 230, "Signature of Employer or Authorized Representative:")
    c.line(50, height - 245, 300, height - 245)
    
    c.drawString(320, height - 230, "Date (mm/dd/yyyy):")
    c.rect(320, height - 245, 100, 20)
    
    # Employer Info
    c.drawString(50, height - 270, "Print Name of Employer or Authorized Representative:")
    c.rect(50, height - 285, 200, 20)
    
    c.drawString(260, height - 270, "Title:")
    c.rect(260, height - 285, 150, 20)
    
    # Save the PDF
    c.save()
    print(f"I-9 form created: {filename}")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    # Create I-9 form in the Admin directory
    pdf_path = "/tmp/Documents/Admin/i-9.pdf"
    create_i9_form(pdf_path)

    import os

        print(f"I-9 PDF successfully created at: {pdf_path}")
    else:
        print("Failed to create I-9 PDF")

#!/usr/bin/env python3
import sys
import os
import random
from PyPDF2 import PdfReader, PdfWriter

def trim_pdf(input_path, output_path, percentage=0.3):
    """
    Trim a PDF by randomly selecting a percentage of its pages.
    
    Args:
        input_path (str): Path to the input PDF file
        output_path (str): Path where the trimmed PDF will be saved
        percentage (float): Percentage of pages to keep (default: 0.3 for 30%)
    """
    # Read the input PDF
    reader = PdfReader(input_path)
    total_pages = len(reader.pages)
    
    # Calculate how many pages to keep
    pages_to_keep = max(1, int(total_pages * percentage))
    
    # Randomly select pages to keep
    selected_pages = random.sample(range(total_pages), pages_to_keep)
    selected_pages.sort()  # Keep pages in order
    
    # Create a new PDF with selected pages
    writer = PdfWriter()
    for page_num in selected_pages:
        writer.add_page(reader.pages[page_num])
    
    # Write the output PDF
    with open(output_path, 'wb') as output_file:
        writer.write(output_file)
    
    print(f"Original PDF had {total_pages} pages")
    print(f"Trimmed PDF has {pages_to_keep} pages ({percentage*100:.1f}%)")
    print(f"Selected pages: {selected_pages}")
    print(f"Trimmed PDF saved to: {output_path}")

def main():
    if len(sys.argv) != 2:
        print("Usage: python edit_pdf.py <input_pdf_path>")
